name: LocalizedTextEditor
src_typeComment: A localisation key is an opaque string, so the one thing this inspector has to answer is "did I spell it right, and what does it actually say?" — without entering Play mode. It shows the key's text in every language the project has, and offers a picker of the keys that really exist, which is the difference between a typo caught now and a #ui.strat_button# in a screenshot later.  It also makes the component's one piece of hidden behaviour visible: when a Localized String ASSET is assigned it wins, and the typed Key field is inert. A greyed-out field that says why beats a field that silently does nothing.
